en: Black‑and‑white seaside view showing rocky shoreline with a few small rowboats pulled up on the rocks. Behind the beach stand several large institutional buildings with pitched roofs and a tall chimney, likely a sanatorium complex. In the foreground, printed caption text identifies the location, and in the bottom right there is a small oval logo and publisher information typical of early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcards.
